item.title: Microsoft Azure Hit by Widespread Cloud Connectivity Outage
item.description:
Users report that Microsoft Cloud connections have been down for roughly five minutes, with even the Azure status page unreachable. The incident is still developing, and Microsoft has not issued an official statement, so the scope and root cause remain unconfirmed.

原文标题：微软 Azure 云服务突发大面积连接中断

Why it matters：头部云厂商突发中断直接影响依赖 Azure 的开发者与业务，值得第一时间关注。

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Fast Agentic Workflows
item.description:
Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast and efficient model built for everyday coding and agentic workflows, complementing the deeper long-horizon reasoning of Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon. Hydrogen simultaneously rolls out across all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Google Search, and paid AI Pro/Ultra subscribers, marking the broad democratization of Gemini 4 capabilities.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 主打高速智能体工作流

Why it matters：Gemini 4 系列新增高速成员并全面下放至搜索与订阅产品，是前沿模型产品线分层与规模化落地的重要节点。

item.title: Google Releases Model Card for Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description:
Google DeepMind published the model card for Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioning it as a frontier model tuned for speed and efficiency in everyday coding and agentic workflows. The card covers model information, training data, distribution, evaluations and intended-use limitations, and outlines CBRN and cybersecurity misuse mitigations, while the full safety report is still pending.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型卡

Why it matters：谷歌新一代 Gemini 模型首次公开模型卡，是观察其能力定位与安全策略的一手材料。

item.title: Simular Launches Box to Let Multiple AI Agents Share One Cloud Computer
item.description:
Simular AI has launched Box, a cloud computer that any AI agent can connect to. Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini and DeepSeek can all open apps, run the terminal and fill in forms on it, with files and logins persisting across agents. The move decouples agent computer-use setups from any single chatbot, breaking the previously siloed per-vendor environments.

原文标题：Simular 推出 Box 让多个 AI 智能体共享一台云电脑

Why it matters：将智能体的电脑操作环境从单一厂商封闭生态中解耦，是智能体基础设施层值得关注的架构尝试。

item.title: Leeroo Open-Sources Kapso Engine for Iterative Enterprise Data Learning
item.description:
Leeroo has open-sourced Kapso, an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from every run for enterprise data work. The core thesis is that data work is inherently iterative—investigate, hypothesize, experiment, improve—so an AI-native system should automate that loop and compound learning rather than relying on upfront business ontology modeling. The team, with prior large-scale AI systems experience at LinkedIn and Meta, grounds the approach in a lakehouse migration spanning 30+ source-system families and thousands of tables.

原文标题：Leeroo 开源 Kapso 引擎 从企业数据迭代学习

Why it matters：开源企业数据迭代学习引擎，提出可复用的数据工程自动化范式，对数据平台与 Agent 工程读者有参考价值。

item.title: Zeromatter Exits Stealth with Physically Accurate Simulation Platform
item.description:
Zeromatter has emerged from four years of stealth with a self-built renderer, physics engine and simulation platform that creates a physically accurate virtual world for cars, drones, aircraft and robots to train before deployment. Designed around how cameras, lidar and radar perceive, the platform emphasizes deterministic, repeatable tests validated against real data from its own labs.

原文标题：Zeromatter 结束隐身 推出物理精确仿真平台

Why it matters：具身智能与自动驾驶训练正从真实路测转向可复现的仿真，Zeromatter 自研全栈仿真栈值得关注。

item.title: SoftBank's Gas Turbine Overorder Backfires as AI Power Demand Surges
item.description:
SoftBank's SB Energy overbooked more than 13 gigawatts of gas turbines to meet surging AI data center power demand, only to absorb billion-dollar losses as project timelines slipped. The case exposes how AI compute expansion is now constrained by power infrastructure, with natural gas still the near-term workhorse but supply chains and construction cycles forming a real ceiling.

原文标题：软银燃气轮机豪赌失利 超订 13 吉瓦暴露 AI 供电瓶颈

Why it matters：以软银超订燃气轮机的具体财务损失为切口，揭示 AI 算力扩张背后的电力供应硬约束，对关注算力基础设施的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Forty Percent of Game Developers Now Use Generative AI at Work
item.description:
GDC's 2026 State of the Game Industry survey finds 40% of developers now use generative AI as part of their job, up from 36% in 2025, with adoption reaching 58% among free-to-play teams and 70% at mobile-only studios. Concept art and visual ideation dominate usage at 22%, while only 8% apply it to production art or final assets; separately, 34% of respondents report being laid off in the past two years.

原文标题：40% 游戏开发者已在工作中使用生成式 AI

Why it matters：GDC 年度调查给出游戏行业生成式 AI 采用率与裁员数据，是观察 AI 落地渗透的可靠行业信号。

item.title: AI Chatbots Point Shoppers to Fake Retail Sites, Study Finds
item.description:
IP protection firm Podqi tested ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity with 6,795 shopping-related prompts across 151 brands and found all three engines cited and surfaced fake brand-impersonating websites, with Perplexity performing worst at 15% of answers containing risky sites. The study exposes systemic gaps in AI search around brand authenticity and e-commerce referral safety; Perplexity said it never claims 100% accuracy.

原文标题：研究称 AI 聊天机器人推荐假冒零售网站

Why it matters：首次以量化数据揭示主流 AI 搜索在购物场景中推荐假冒网站的风险，对关注 AI 搜索可信度与电商安全的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Phota Labs Launches AI Photo Assistant for Pro-Level Shots
item.description:
Phota Labs, founded by former Adobe computational photography engineers, has launched an iOS app that uses AI to fix the shot itself rather than just apply post-processing filters, aiming to produce professional-looking photos while preserving subjects' natural appearance. The a16z-backed startup raised a $5.6 million seed round and is launching free to build users before exploring freemium and an Android release.

原文标题：Phota Labs 推出 AI 照片助手 一键生成专业级人像

Why it matters：消费级 AI 影像工具的新入局者，创始团队来自 Adobe 计算摄影一线，具备一定技术与资本背书。

item.title: AWS Lambda Web Functions Keep Billing Memory for About 7 Minutes After Last Request
item.description:
Easel.sh's founder reports that AWS Lambda Web Functions continued billing for memory for 5-7 minutes after the last request, prompting the team to build its own compute layer. On the same Next.js app, the in-house stack answered warm requests 1.5-3x faster and cold-started about 3.5x faster.

原文标题：AWS Lambda Web Functions 请求结束后仍计费内存约 7 分钟

Why it matters：揭示了 Serverless 计费模型中被忽视的尾部成本，并给出同应用对比数据，对选型有参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Study Traces How Frontier Models Lose Chain-of-Thought Transparency
item.description:
New OpenAI research pinpoints the specific training stages that erode chain-of-thought (CoT) transparency in frontier models, arguing the loss is not an inevitable law of nature but a byproduct of optimizing for capability and compute cost. The work warns that scratchpad-based safety monitoring will grow increasingly unreliable as pretraining scales, urging new oversight methods.

原文标题：OpenAI 研究揭示前沿模型思维链透明度流失机制

Why it matters：首次系统定位思维链透明度流失的训练成因，对 AI 安全监控范式具有直接影响。

item.title: AWS Adds Bedrock Knowledge Base Migration Guide to Coding Agent Toolkit
item.description:
AWS added a knowledge base migration guide to the amazon-bedrock skill in its Agent Toolkit for AWS, helping teams move from customer-managed vector stores to Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base. The guide lets a coding agent run read-only discovery, produce a line-by-line reviewable migration plan, and create the new knowledge base and data sources after approval.

Why it matters：这是 AWS 官方工具链的实用更新，为使用 Bedrock 的团队提供了可操作的迁移路径。

item.title: Millionways Launches Thorsten-4 Large Psychology Model
item.description:
Millionways has launched Thorsten-4, a Large Psychology Model that scores each person in a conversation across 50 behavioral and psychological traits. Its training data comes from over 35 million words hand-tagged by trained psychologists from repeated interviews with more than 7,000 people over four years, rather than scraped web text. The model aims to move from reading text to reading people, predicting hesitation, withholding and disengagement.

原文标题：Thorsten-4 发布 用 3500 万词训练心理大模型

Why it matters：首个以人工标注真实访谈数据训练的心理学专用大模型，开辟垂直基座新方向。

The board named 13-year CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO and launched an internal and external search for a permanent successor, with new Board Chair Harvey Jones informing employees of an 'extraordinarily difficult period.'

item.title: AWS Publishes A2A Reference Architecture for Cross-Org Multi-Agent Systems
item.description:
AWS published a reference architecture built on the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol that lets multi-agent systems spanning organizational boundaries discover each other, communicate, and exchange tasks via Agent Card registration, without shared frameworks or exposed internals. The design pairs a LangChain-based orchestrator with Strands Agents-built agents, targeting ISVs and enterprises exposing agents across boundaries.

原文标题：AWS 发布 A2A 多智能体跨组织互操作参考架构

Why it matters：为跨组织多智能体互操作提供了可落地的协议与部署范式，对构建开放智能体生态的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Adds Fine-Grained Access Control to Knowledge Base Tools
item.description:
Amazon introduced fine-grained access control for Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools, ensuring agents searching internal documents on a user's behalf only return content that user is permitted to see. The capability targets cross-user data leakage in shared departmental assistants and multi-tenant SaaS architectures by scoping retrieval per user.

原文标题：亚马逊 Bedrock 知识库新增细粒度访问控制

Why it matters：面向企业智能体落地的权限隔离能力，解决多租户检索越权这一真实工程痛点。

item.title: Amazon Introduces Agent DLC Framework for Production Agents
item.description:
Amazon introduces the Agent Development Lifecycle (Agent DLC), arguing that moving agents from prototype to production requires one lifecycle, two loops, and a single explicit standard for judging every change, since traditional unit tests and CI/CD are necessary but insufficient for agents. A measured case shows how an aggregate metric can mask a coverage problem, motivating repeatable, affordable evaluation, with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore providing observability, runtime, tool integration, and memory management.

原文标题：亚马逊提出 Agent DLC 框架 推动智能体生产化

Why it matters：为智能体工程化落地提供了可复用的评估与生命周期方法论，并给出聚合指标掩盖覆盖缺陷的实证案例。

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns as Market Value Plunges $550 Billion
item.description:
Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO amid a scandal, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim chief, triggering a broad selloff across global AI stocks. Nvidia fell 8.2% intraday, dropping below a $4 trillion market cap for the first time since July 2025, with over $550 billion wiped out since the board opened its investigation; CoreWeave and Nebius also slumped, while AMD and Broadcom rose 3.7% and 5.6%. The shakeup exposes risks in Nvidia's circular chip-and-infrastructure financing model and forces a repricing of the entire AI supply chain.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 市值蒸发 5500 亿美元

Why it matters：英伟达最高层突发变动叠加巨额市值蒸发，是足以重塑全球 AI 算力与资本市场格局的节点性事件。

item.title: Show HN Launches Arcade of One-Shot Fable 5.2 HTML Games
item.description:
A developer launched Fable52.games, an arcade showcasing single-file HTML 3D games generated end-to-end by Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 from one detailed prompt over hours of autonomous agentic coding. Each game inlines markup, CSS, JavaScript, shaders and synthesized audio into one .html file, running offline via WebGL and the Web Audio API with no server or build step. The site also exposes the original prompts and accepts community submissions, offering an interactive window into long-horizon agent coding.

原文标题：Show HN 上线 Fable 5.2 单文件 HTML 游戏展示站

Why it matters：以可玩可查提示词的方式直观展示长程智能体一次性生成完整 3D 游戏的能力，是评估自主编码智能体的实用样本。

Why it matters：为广受欢迎的开源白板工具补上 Apple 平台原生客户端，并接入 AI 辅助与 MCP，对工具链读者有实际参考价值。

item.title: Running Up to 16B Parameter LLMs on a 1.9GB RAM TV Box
item.description:
The smolmaxxing project demonstrates running language models from 260K to 16B parameters on a Xiaomi TV Box S (Amlogic S7D, ~1GB usable RAM, no root) using custom kernels, smarter memory use and weight streaming. Qwen3.5-0.8B reaches 16.8 tok/s (2.2x stock), while an 8B MoE model hits 7.2 tok/s via on-demand expert paging from flash. All claims are measured back-to-back on real hardware, offering a reproducible engineering playbook for edge-side local inference.

原文标题：在 1.9 GB 内存电视盒子上跑通 16B 参数模型

Why it matters：在极低内存消费级硬件上跑通 16B 级模型并给出可复现实测数据，对边缘推理与端侧部署有直接参考价值。

item.title: Linux 下为四张 32 GB 显卡配置可调整 BAR
item.description:
作者在 Broadcom PEX88096 PCIe 交换芯片后接入四张 AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 与两张 RTX 3090，每卡分配八条通道。由于 ROCm 的 P2P 仅在每卡完整 32 GB BAR 映射时启用，作者编写了内核模块 gpu-rebar-layout 在 Linux 上完成 Resizable BAR 调整，并指出上游补丁仅修复尺寸计算，该主板仍需模块完成重设。

Why it matters：面向多卡本地推理与训练玩家，给出了 PCIe 交换芯片下 Resizable BAR 与 ROCm P2P 的实操路径与内核模块。
